dvids.title: Readout of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw’s Meeting with Royal Saudi Defense Leaders
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. -- Commander of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces (NAVCENT/C5F/CMF) Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw met with Saudi defense leaders during a trip to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Oct. 6-7.

dvids.title: Carrier Air Wing 9 completes 10-month combat deployment
dvids.desc: SAN DIEGO — Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 9 has concluded a 10-month combat deployment aboard Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72), Oct. 8. Since embarking Nov. 21, 2025, the Navy’s premier next-generation air wing served as the primary offensive power for the Abraham Lincoln Carrier
